VIDEO SCRIPT: FRACTIONS
Grade: Grade 3 · Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Fractions. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• Denominator = equal parts of the whole.

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• 1/2 of 12 = 6
• 1/4 of 20 = 5

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Find 1/2 and 1/4 of classroom totals (learners, desks).

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Fractions.”
